summary.intent: Continue a series of cleanup PRs by rewriting history-style comments in production Rust code (e.g. 'previously', 'formerly', 'no longer', audit/bug IDs, spec IDs) into present-tense statements of what the code guarantees.
summary.outcome: Created branch docs/comments-present-tense off origin/main, hand-rewrote about 50 comments across ~38 files, removed all spec IDs from code, and verified with cargo check, clippy -D warnings, rustdoc -D warnings and the full test suite. Committed and pushed the branch, and ran a merge-tree check against #454 and an `entire trail link 237` call; their results are not shown in the transcript.

repo: AGENTS.md has a rule that code never cites spec IDs (patterns like WS-*, VER-*, REL-*, CLI-*, MAT-*); the cleanup removed all such references from .rs files.
Many history-style comment hits in crates/**/src are test docs inside src files, so a filter that excludes tests/ directories still catches them.
Only PR #454 (branch docs/align-with-code) and the release PR were open, so this comment-wide PR was held for last to minimize merge conflicts.
The repo is a Rust workspace of crates: callisto-cli, callisto-graph, callisto-manifests, callisto-model and callisto-fixtures.

code.finding: A comment claimed CargoToml did not use FormatFingerprint, but it does (cargo.rs:21,34). The comment was actively wrong and was rewritten, not just reworded.

workflow: Comment edits can't be caught by the compiler, so the transcript used a regex search for history words, read each hit in context via helper scripts (ctx.py, ranges.py), applied exact-replacement scripts, and skimmed `git diff -U0` added lines at the end.
Batching the rewrites (3 batches) with `cargo fmt` and `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` after each caught problems early.
Used `git merge-tree --write-tree` to test merge compatibility with another open PR branch without touching the working tree.
Ran Python helper scripts with `-I` and kept them in a separate tmp directory, per the environment guidance.

friction: Context windows from the grep output were often shorter than the full comment blocks, so extra range-reading passes were needed before rewriting.
The first regex produced about 50 hits, including many in test docs, which required manual triage rather than automated replacement.
open_items: The merge-tree result against #454 and the `entire trail link 237` output were not visible in the transcript and need to be confirmed.
The PR for docs/comments-present-tense was pushed but its creation or review status isn't shown.

Some files with history-style comments were edited (e.g. crates/callisto-model/src/format/changeset/tests.rs and integration tests under crates/callisto-cli/tests), and the search excluded tests directories, so other test-file comments may remain.
